tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: OEM should have prior experience in similar systems. Project credentials / Client certificates

Bidder shall have adequate technical manpower and service support mechanism in India. The bidder shall have a service support office in India and furnish an undertaking to provide technical support and maintenance services in India throughout the Warranty and AMC periods. Technical staff details, training certificates, service infrastructure details (also submit the service support form given in Annexure- J)

The OEM(s) of the projection system, dome, software, and critical equipment shall provide a warranty and support undertaking confirming availability of technical support, software updates, firmware updates, and spare parts for a minimum period of ten years from the date of Final Acceptance. OEM Support Undertaking/Manufacturers Commitment Letter.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- OEM Warranty and Support Commitment

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Financial Capacity- Minimum Annual Average Turnover (MAAT) of Rs. 2.10 Crore during last 3 financial years. Bidder shall have positive net worth in the latest audited financial year. CA Certified Turnover Certificate, Audited Balance Sheet, P&L.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall be a Company / LLP / Partnership / Proprietorship / Consortium / Joint Venture registered under relevant laws. Certificate of Incorporation / Registration, GST Certificate, PAN Card.
Bidder shall be OEM or Authorized Dealer / System Integrator. Authorization must be project-specific. OEM Authorization Letter

Experience in Design, Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of minimum 10m diameter 4K 2D Digital Full Dome Planetarium Systems during last 5 years, having successfully completed similar work(s) with a value not less than 80 percentage of the estimated project cost. The bidder shall have completed at least two similar installations worldwide, including one in India, that has been operational for a minimum period of six (6) months prior to the bid submission date. Work Orders clearly indicating project value, Completion Certificates, Project Details, OEM Details, and Client Performance Certificates indicating operational status (also submit the form in the proforma under Annexure B).
Bidder shall comply with statutory requirements. GST Certificate, PAN, Tax Clearance Certificate (if applicable)
Bidder shall submit undertaking and declarations. Undertaking, Declaration for no blacklisting, no false information, not under liquidation
Lead partner shall meet financial criteria, consortium as a whole shall meet technical criteria. MOU on Stamp Paper, roles and responsibilities, authorization of lead partner.
Employer reserves right to verify documents, inspect projects, and reject bids for misrepresentation or poor performance. Self-declaration / acceptance by bidder

Only eligible bidders will be considered. Incomplete or misleading submissions will lead to disqualification. The Purchaser reserves the right to seek clarifications and additional documents in support of qualification claims. Signed Compliance Statement
